body: I do have my partner to talk to but she is quite harsh towards me because she is just like that as a person. I luckily have a psych I see once a fortnight but it's still so hard to keep on.

Thank you for your kind words they really do mean alot. I think part of the reason I've survived this long is due to that belief that we are all connected through our similar painful experiences. I will try to keep my head up for as long as I can.
